steps.t: Check eligibility with a soft check in seconds

Affirm pays Xiluet. You pay Affirm monthly

faq.a: Depending on your plan, 0 to 36 percent APR. The exact amount is shown before you accept, and it never changes.

faq.q: What if I miss a payment?
faq.a: Affirm does not charge late fees, but late payments may affect your credit and future eligibility.
Yes, with no penalty. You only pay interest for the time you had the loan.

disclaimer: Affirm is a third-party lender. Financing is subject to credit approval. Terms and rates are set by Affirm and may change. Xiluet does not make credit decisions.
